info.name: Identify a user, group a user into a company, or track a custom event

items.docs: Single ingestion endpoint dispatched by the `type` field. Use `identify` to sync user traits (on signup, login, or profile update), `group` to associate a user with a company or organization (essential for B2B analytics), and `track` to record a custom event such as a purchase or feature usage.

Forward events collected by the Userlens JavaScript SDK. This is the endpoint a proxy server should use when routing SDK events through your own backend. Accepts auto-captured clicks (XPath + DOM snapshot), custom pushed events, and page views.
